title: Combined-Program Credit in the Month a Wraparound Seat Starts
content:
**Rule.** The combined-program credit of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions follows how the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program bills the same month. The credit for the Pre-K enrollment's most recent billing month depends on the start date of the child's Pre-K Wraparound seat, compared with that billing month and with the plan's half-month start day (the 16th on Creek Kids Club Pre-K Wraparound Care (5 Days)).

| Start date of the Pre-K Wraparound seat | Share of the credit given for the billing month |
|---|---|
| in a month after the billing month | none: no credit for the month |
| in the billing month, on or after the plan's half-month start day (the 16th) | half of the credit |
| in the billing month before the 16th, or in any earlier month | the whole credit |

## Examples (hypothetical, billing month November)

| Seat start date | Share |
|---|---|
| 2 December | none |
| 16 November | half |
| 15 November | whole |
| 3 September | whole |
